tasks.label: Verify Copilot attachment authentication
tasks.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$attached = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'TaskbarBuddy/connections/*.json') | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } | Where-Object { $_.stage -eq 'attached' -and $_.port -and (Get-Process -Id $_.processId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $attached) { throw 'No live successful attachment diagnostic exists.' }
& 'C:/Program Files/dotnet/dotnet.exe' run --file tools/Test-CopilotAuthentication.cs -- $attached.port
exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Try Copilot attachment once
Inspect Copilot connection authentication
Build Copilot attachment fix
